title: Men's Golf – Fairways Are a Rumor Hoodie

seo.title: Funny Golf Hoodie for Men: Fairways Are a Rumor
seo.description: A funny golf hoodie for men: a lost golfer in plus fours squinting past the trees, FAIRWAYS ARE A RUMOR. Printed to order, free US shipping on $45+.

descriptionHtml:
The Story

This funny golf hoodie is for the weekend golfer whose drives find the trees more often than the fairway and who has stopped pretending otherwise.

A golfer in a cable-knit sweater, cap and red plaid plus fours shades his eyes in a thicket of tall pines, a lost ball at his feet and a far-off flag the only sign of a fairway. FAIRWAYS runs above in heavy navy slab letters and ARE A RUMOR. below in rust red.

Pull it on for early tee times, the clubhouse patio and any round played mostly from the rough. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed to order.

Details & Fit

  • Classic unisex fit, pullover with a double-lined hood and matching drawcord
  • 50% pre-shrunk cotton, 50% polyester
  • Fabric weight: 8.0 oz/yd²
  • Air-jet spun yarn with a soft feel
  • Front pouch pocket, ribbed cuffs and waistband with spandex
  • Sizes S–3XL
  • Colors: Sand, Sport Grey
  • Blank product sourced from Bangladesh, Nicaragua, Honduras or El Salvador

Questions

What colors does it come in?
The Men's Golf Fairways Are a Rumor hoodie comes in Sand and Sport Grey. The navy FAIRWAYS line, rust red ARE A RUMOR. line and dark linework all read clearly on both light blanks, a choice from Graphic Tees Co. so every word stays easy to read from the next cart over.

Is it a good gift for a golfer?
Yes. The Men's Golf Fairways Are a Rumor hoodie from Graphic Tees Co. gives a high-handicap golfer a joke his whole foursome will recognize, on an 8 oz 50/50 fleece that is warm for early tee times. Order by about December 8 for Christmas delivery with free US shipping over $45.

How does the Fairways Are a Rumor hoodie fit?
The Graphic Tees Co. Fairways Are a Rumor hoodie is a classic unisex pullover cut in sizes S through 3XL. Order your usual size for a regular fit, or go up one size for a roomier fit over a quarter-zip or a base layer on a cold morning round.

How do I care for it?
Machine wash this Graphic Tees Co. hoodie cold, inside out, with similar colors, then tumble dry low. The 8 oz 50% cotton, 50% polyester fleece is pre-shrunk, and washing inside out keeps the navy and rust red print and the pine forest scene looking sharp season after season.

Where does the print sit?
The Fairways Are a Rumor print sits across the chest above the front pouch pocket, with FAIRWAYS over the lost golfer and ARE A RUMOR. beneath, so both lines read from across the first tee. The hood is double-lined with a matching drawcord for chilly mornings.
